dict.string: Nemo listens for the wake word "Nemo" to activate the AI assistant. The microphone stays active in the background for hands-free operation.
Nemo uses on-device speech recognition to detect the wake word and transcribe your voice commands.
When the app is open, Nemo captures a camera frame to give the AI visual context about your surroundings.
Nemo uses your location to provide safety information about nearby restaurants, transit, and street conditions.
